_comment: Asset registry — every reusable asset carries a classification (what it contains) and an approval (which lane it may be used in). The renderer refuses assets not approved for the lane requesting them. Classification is a HUMAN judgement recorded here; audit-assets.py only enforces what is written. See agent-fleet-roadmap.md agent 12 and the audio policy in reel-creation-pipeline.md.

_schema.classification: vocal | vocal+daf | ambience | instrumental | mascot | scene
_schema.lanes: which lanes may use this asset: kids, adults, or both
_schema.verified: true once a human has listened to or viewed the asset and confirmed the classification. false = present but unconfirmed; the audit reports it.
_schema.notes: why it is classified this way, or why it was retired
